client.question: How do I place an order for Builder or Music services?
client.answer: Choose a service on our Services section, then submit the contact form or open a ticket on Discord. Include your in-game name, World ID, and references so we can quote accurately.

client.question: Is my Crystal Realms account safe during the process?
client.answer: Yes. All work is done by hand by trusted team members. We never use exploits, hacks, or third-party software.

client.question: How long does a custom Realm build take?
client.answer: Small layouts: 1–2 days. Premium ROTD-level worlds: typically 4–7 days depending on complexity and queue.

client.question: Can you recreate any song for the Music Service?
client.answer: Most anime, gaming, and pop references can be adapted. Send a YouTube link and we'll confirm feasibility before starting.

client.question: Do I need to provide materials myself?
client.answer: You can supply materials in chests, or add our full-service materials package to your order.

client.question: Will I get progress updates?
client.answer: Yes — daily screenshots and status updates from the assigned team member until delivery.

staff.question: How do I join World Service as staff?
staff.answer: Scroll to the Careers section, pick your role, and apply via our Discord server. Share your portfolio or past work samples.

staff.question: What is the 5% tax mentioned in your ecosystem?
staff.answer: World Service runs a fair marketplace with a 5% tax on completed jobs to fund equipment lending, moderation, and platform upkeep.

staff.question: Do you lend equipment to new staff?
staff.answer: Active and verified members can access equipment lending programs — details are shared after you pass the application review.

staff.question: How are jobs assigned?
staff.answer: Orders enter a queue on Discord. Admins match jobs to builders, composers, or harvesters based on skill fit and availability.

staff.question: Can I work part-time?
staff.answer: Yes. Many staff members take orders around their play schedule. Clear communication and reliable delivery matter more than hours logged.
